newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends down as commercial interest wanes.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends down as commercial interest wanes.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower in thin volume with a decline in commercial interest noted, traders said.
"Commercial activity was absent today. There was nothing that stood out as obvious commercial business," a trader said.
Traders said the market remains pressed by producer offerings over the market and by a weak tone in the benchmark Thai market.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 250 contracts, below the 294 traded Wednesday, according to the CBOT.
Rice futures closed five to 9-1/2 cents per cwt lower, with January down seven at $10.45 per cwt.
